# CANDIDATE: VOLATILITY_COMPRESSION_BREAKOUT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

After a period of low volatility (contracting ATR5 relative to ATR20 for three consecutive bars), a breakout accompanied by a volume surge (>1.5x 20-bar average volume) tends to continue, offering a short-term edge. This setup captures momentum from volatility contraction followed by expansion, which often precedes sustained directional moves.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** Compute 5-bar ATR (ATR5) and 20-bar ATR (ATR20). If ATR5 < 0.7 * ATR20 for three consecutive bars, then wait for a close above the highest high of the prior 20 bars with volume > 1.5 * average volume of the last 20 bars (long) OR close below the lowest low of the prior 20 bars with same volume condition (short). Enter at the close of the breakout bar.  
**Exit:** Initial stop at the opposite edge of the 20-bar range (below the low for longs, above the high for shorts). Target at 2R (twice the risk) OR use a premium stop of 0.5% of underlying price with a runner trailing 15% of ATR. Regime filter: only active when VIX is between 15-25 and time is 10:00-11:30 EST; avoid choppy low-volume afternoons.

6. **Concentration:** Unknown; requires backtest to determine if top-5 days drive P&L.
